critical_summary: No executable case generator: generator.py defines seed namespaces only.
No benchmark execution entrypoint: runner.py cannot execute the 480-case benchmark or apply primary gates.
Primary metrics declared in protocol are not implemented in scorer.py.
major_summary: case_manifest.json is a design summary rather than frozen case bytes or a derivation recipe.
Claim leakage cannot be excluded because evidence_text may encode class labels and no observation schema/generator is frozen.
Hash guard matches its six files but excludes environment lock, case bytes, output schema and a complete execution entrypoint.
verified_strengths: Primary gates are holdout-scoped by name.
Six declared hash-guard files verify exactly.
admissible() blocks estimation when frame permission or compatibility is false.
claim_prediction() does not accept claim_class directly.
required_remediation: Create a new protocol ID with frozen executable generator or full case bytes, complete runner, all metric implementations, anti-leakage observation schema/tests, environment lock and full execution hash guard; then repeat preflight before execution.
boundary: Synthetic benchmark assurance only; no historical, archaeological, muography, physical-geometry or construction-method validation.
